download_tableformer_models: download the tableformer model artifacts from Hugging Face Hub to a local directory
run_table_structure_prediction: run table structure prediction on a page batch using the tableformer model to extract table layouts and cells
create_table_structure_model: create a table structure model instance with enabled flag, artifacts path, options, and accelerator options
draw_table_and_cells_debug: draw table boundaries and cell rectangles on a page image for debugging visualization
test_table_structure_model: test the table structure model with a conversion result and page batch to verify table detection accuracy
